bead.title: Harden pause semantics: optional intake quiesce and documented lease behavior
bead.description:
PROBLEM
Pause exists but its semantics are under-specified for the experimentation workflow (TD-009): claims stop, but whether intake (push) is blocked is undefined, and lease behavior under pause is undocumented. Branching needs a queue that can be quiesced to a stable position.

CURRENT STATE
- QueueCommand::PauseQueue/ResumeQueue are durable log commands (crates/pqueue-engine/src/command.rs:59-60,584-585).
- Projection carries paused: bool (crates/pqueue-projection/src/lib.rs:165), is_paused (:1882), select_eligible returns empty while paused (:1887), round-trips through ProjectionImage (:1266,1286).
- Push is not obviously blocked by pause; discovery stays pause-agnostic (crates/pqueue-engine/src/port.rs:818-819).

PROPOSED FIX
Per TD-009 section 1: extend PauseQueue with an intake mode (drain_intake flag or variant) so pause can optionally reject/queue pushes, enabling full quiesce-to-position before branch; keep claim-stop behavior; document that in-flight leases continue on their normal clock (pause neither extends nor cancels) and that discovery reports eligibility buildup during pause. Pause/resume emit change records once the emission foundation lands (no hard dependency; the log commands already exist).

NON-SCOPE
- Branch (separate bead). Changes to lease/renewal semantics.
bead.acceptance:
1. pause_blocks_claims_and_optionally_intake: while paused, claims return empty; with intake-blocking pause, push is rejected with a structured error (or deferred per the chosen mode); with plain pause, push still lands. cargo test -p pqueue-engine pause_blocks_claims_and_optionally_intake
2. pause_does_not_alter_lease_clock: an in-flight lease expires on its normal clock during pause and the item becomes claimable after resume. cargo test -p pqueue-engine pause_does_not_alter_lease_clock
3. cargo test -p pqueue-engine and cargo test -p pqueue-projection pass.
